Definition: from G1405; a drachma or (silver) coin (as handled):--piece (of silver).
BiblicalUsage: A drachma, the silver coin the woman lost, swept the house to find, and called her friends to rejoice over when it was found.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one lost coin is worth lighting a lamp and sweeping the house for, because God rejoices over one sinner who repents.
